De-Identify a DICOM File, Directory, or Cohort

Source: R/deid.R
dicom_deid.Rd

De-identifies single DICOM files or entire cohorts according to DICOM PS3.15 Annex E application-level confidentiality profiles and optional statutory jurisdiction overlays (e.g. HIPAA Safe Harbor, Singapore PDPA/HIB, GDPR). Provides deterministic pseudonymization, longitudinal UID and date consistency, parallel execution via mirai, structured JSONL audit logging, and ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted crosswalk generation.

Usage

dicom_deid(
  path,
  out_dir = NULL,
  profile = "ps3.15",
  options = character(0),
  jurisdictions = NULL,
  key = NULL,
  layout = c("preserve", "hierarchy", "flat"),
  workers = 1L,
  audit_path = NULL,
  crosswalk_path = NULL,
  override_tags = list(),
  drop_wsi_labels = TRUE,
  pixel_method = c("none", "blackout", "inpaint"),
  pixel_boxes = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Character vector of one or more DICOM file paths, or a directory path.

out_dir

Output directory path. If NULL, a temporary directory is created.

profile

Character string identifying the base profile, or a compiled dicom_deid_profile object. Default is "ps3.15".

options

Character vector of standard PS3.15 options to enable.

jurisdictions

Optional character vector of statutory jurisdiction overlays.

key

Optional dicom_key_provider object. If NULL, a local key provider is generated.

layout

Character string specifying output directory layout:

  • "preserve" (default): Preserves relative subdirectory structure.

  • "hierarchy": Formats as <pseudo_pid>/<pseudo_study>/<pseudo_sop>.dcm.

  • "flat": Places all files directly in out_dir as <pseudo_sop>.dcm.

workers

Integer number of parallel workers. When workers > 1L and the mirai package is available, files are processed concurrently.

audit_path

Optional file path where structured JSONL audit records will be written.

crosswalk_path

Optional file path where the AEAD-encrypted crosswalk will be saved.

override_tags

Optional named list of tag-action overrides.

drop_wsi_labels

Logical. Whether whole slide microscopy (WSI) label and overview instances should be skipped. Default is TRUE.

pixel_method

Character string specifying pixel de-identification method: "none" (default), "blackout", or "inpaint". If options contains "clean_pixel" and pixel_method == "none", defaults to "blackout".

pixel_boxes

Optional data frame or matrix with candidate pixel bounding boxes (ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax).

overwrite

Logical. Whether existing output files should be overwritten. Default is FALSE.

Value

An object of class "dicom_deid_result" containing:

files

Character vector of successfully written de-identified DICOM files.

summary

Tibble summarizing input/output paths, digests, pseudonyms, and action counts.

actions_total

Named integer vector of total tag actions applied.

skipped_wsi_labels

Count of skipped WSI label/overview instances.

audit_path

Path to audit JSONL file if requested, or NULL.

crosswalk_path

Path to encrypted crosswalk file if requested, or NULL.

profile

The resolved dicom_deid_profile object.

jurisdictions

Character vector of active jurisdictions.

key_provider

The dicom_key_provider used.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
kp <- dicom_key_provider(passphrase = "my-secret-passphrase")
res <- dicom_deid("path/to/dicom/dir", "path/to/out/dir", key = kp)
print(res)
} # }
